verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs cover progressive rollouts, scheduled incremental steps up to 100%, and guarded rollouts that ramp traffic to 100%. A community user confirms percentage rollouts, and clients stream flag changes, so ramping needs no redeploy. However, nothing in the pack documents consistent or sticky bucketing of contexts across ramp steps, so coverage is only partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation of consistent bucketing as the percentage increases, explicit 1%-granularity ramp evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of a full ramp.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll a flag out progressively by percentage with consistent bucketing, ramping from 1% to 100% without redeploying

citations.quote: This topic explains how to create and manage progressive rollouts to release new features incrementally.
You can create a progressive delivery strategy by scheduling the incremental steps to release your feature to 100% of your user base.
A guarded rollout progressively increases traffic to the new variation while monitoring selected metrics for regressions until the rollout reaches 100%.
custom rollout by % of users or attributes
LaunchDarkly clients download all flags in the project on connection, then stream changes.
